INSERT INTO demo_messages (session_id, sender, body, latency_ms) VALUES (($1)::bigint, 'ai', $2, 4000) RETURNING id;

parameters.query: WITH s AS (SELECT id, city FROM demo_sessions WHERE token = $1), ins AS (INSERT INTO demo_messages (session_id, sender, body)         SELECT id, 'lead', $2 FROM s RETURNING session_id) SELECT s.id AS session_id, s.city,   COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(CASE WHEN sender='ai' THEN 'Dispatcher: '      ELSE 'Customer: ' END || body, E'\n' ORDER BY id)    FROM demo_messages m WHERE m.session_id = s.id), '')   || E'\nCustomer: ' || $2 AS transcript FROM s;

WITH m AS (INSERT INTO demo_messages (session_id, sender, body, latency_ms)            VALUES (($1)::bigint, 'ai', $2, 3000) RETURNING session_id), b AS (INSERT INTO demo_bookings (session_id, job_type, tech, slot_at)       SELECT ($1)::bigint, $4, 'next available technician', ($5)::timestamptz       WHERE ($3)::boolean       ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, slot_at, job_type) UPDATE demo_sessions SET booked_at = CASE WHEN ($3)::boolean   THEN COALESCE(booked_at, now()) ELSE booked_at END WHERE id = ($1)::bigint RETURNING id;

parameters.query: SELECT json_build_object(  'messages', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(      'sender', sender, 'body', body,       'at', to_char(created_at, 'HH24:MI:SS')) ORDER BY id)     FROM demo_messages WHERE session_id = s.id), '[]'::json),   'booking', (SELECT json_build_object('job', job_type, 'tech', tech,       'slot', to_char(slot_at, 'Dy DD Mon, HH24:MI'))     FROM demo_bookings WHERE session_id = s.id)) AS state FROM demo_sessions s WHERE s.token = $1;
